title: Classified lists of uncorrelated targets since the 1960s
place_text: Earth orbit; US Space Force, NASA, ESA

tellings.quote: What I didn't know is that there's apparently since the early 1960s, there were something called uncorrelated targets.

plain: Since the early 1960s, the astronomer Beatriz Villarroel says, there have been classified lists of "uncorrelated targets": objects tracked in orbit around Earth that do not match anything known. She tells Michels it was news to her, something she learned from others rather than saw herself, and the lists are tied to bodies such as the US Space Force, NASA and the European Space Agency. If true, it would mean space trackers have long logged unexplained objects near Earth and kept the record secret.
